strings.JNR_WYLDER_LORE: The Wylder awakens once again, straining against the confines of his bunk. The ache of idleness eats at him like a parasite. Days have bled into weeks into months, in his long journey to the planet.  The dream of twin horses, running free through lush green fields, fades from his mind; as it has time and again. In its place is her. Her smile, the glint of a single silver earring. He clutches onto these aged memories as a treasure, but they too fade into nothingness.   All that remains is his charge. He must find her, wherever she may be. If stepping beyond time itself is what is required of him to find her, that is what he will do. The intercom interrupts and blares out a voice.  "We've arrived, pack up and get ready to drop."  As he readies himself, he ensures that his most important possession remains safe. A lone silver earring, long separated from its match. His ears numb to the mechanical screeching of the doors and rush of the airlock venting, leaving but the last words she shared with him.  "Good bye for now, dear brother. Once we're done, we'll meet again."
